paper_title: Axion-Like Particles and Recent Observations of the Cosmic Infrared Background Radiation
notes: This paper identifies a favored/allowed region in the (m_a, g_agamma) plane (m_a ~ 7e-10 to 5e-8 eV, g_agamma ~ 1.5e-11 to 8.8e-10 GeV^-1) that resolves the tension between CIBER CIB data and TeV gamma-ray observations via photon-axion mixing. This is an allowed/preferred region, not an exclusion limit or sensitivity projection. The numerical contour data is only available as plots (Fig. 5); no tabulated values are given, so no reliable (mass, coupling) pairs can be extracted. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: This plot (Fig. 5) shows an ALLOWED region (closed contour) rather than a standard exclusion boundary.
